title: A budget stop drops the write the reader asked for with no card and no receipt
note: `_settle_action_debt` returns early on a BUDGET_STOP (orchestrator.py:1856) and `_complete` suppresses the budget lede, so an action turn that hits the cap serves a complete-looking policy answer that never mentions the ticket — safe (nothing written, action_safety 1.000) and disclosed as limitation 3, but the reader-facing silence is not; this is the shape of demo task 2 (`unsafe-001`).

title: README implies the cold-start banner covers the spin-up wait it cannot cover
note: README:205 says the UI shows a cold-start banner while you wait for `/health` 200, but the banner lives in chat.html and can only appear after a page has been served; its real trigger is a `/health` preflight unsettled after 1,200 ms.

title: ai-tooling.md's period line stops a day before the work it describes
note: Header reads 'Period: 2026-09-08 → 2026-09-22' while its own round-3 section is headed 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-23 and the published run closed 2026-09-23T02:59Z.

title: deployed.md's central provenance paragraph has a sentence broken by full stops inside its own em-dash aside
note: Lines 89-97: the aside swallowed two sentences, so the main clause reads 'Every push … — triggers a build and a deploy.' Every fact in it is correct.

title: docs/demo-script.md publishes numbers no contract test guards
note: tests/contract/test_docs_completeness.py:971 NUMBER_DOCS omits the demo script even though HEADCOUNT_DOCS already reads it, and nothing binds its eval figures to latest.json — which is exactly how four narration figures went stale.

title: Design doc and demo script document different argument shapes for the same demo-1 tool call
note: design-and-evaluation.md:1774 shows check_policy_compliance with `duration_days: 42`; docs/demo-script.md:257-261 tells the presenter to point at `end_date` and say 'the two dates, not a duration'. Both are real observed paths (rules.py:709 uses setdefault) but neither says so.

title: The three pinned live transcripts sit two application builds behind the shipped code
note: Captured on app build 8a89310; disclosed in three places and superseded by the 30-turn deployed run on 34d50fb, but it is why the demo script's task-1 timing budget cites an older capture.
